subject.title: /stop abort leaves streaming card in idle state, blocking subsequent messages (replies=0)

question: Should this stay as a separate Feishu `/stop` abort bug until a live current-main trace proves the owner boundary, or should maintainers fold it into a broader Feishu streaming-card/session recovery item?
rationale: Current main has several adjacent fixes and open Feishu delivery trackers, but the exact CardKit `/stop` path still lacks live proof and could require a shared reply-run fix, a Feishu stream cleanup fix, or both.

options.title: Require Feishu Trace First
options.body: Keep this issue open separately and capture a redacted current-main `/stop` then follow-up trace before scoping an automated fix.

options.title: Assign Shared Abort Ownership
options.body: Treat the shared reply-run active-abort admission path as the primary owner and require Feishu regression coverage for stream settlement.

options.title: Fold Into Feishu Streaming Tracker
options.body: Move the remaining work under the broader Feishu streaming-card tracker only if the live trace shows the shared abort admission path is not involved.

recommendation.title: Require Feishu Trace First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open separately and capture a redacted current-main `/stop` then follow-up trace before scoping an automated fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved Feishu CardKit state boundary routes best to the original streaming-card implementation history before deciding whether shared reply-run changes are also required.
